turns.text: Hi, I'm Owen's teacher. Thanks for coming in.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Okay. Setting the grade aside for a second.
The grade is why I'm here, so it doesn't go aside. Who decided, and when?
If you were me, what would you do here? Genuinely.
You're asking me how to do your job? Answer my question.
